lead_independence.headline: Vero Beach woman arrested on warrant for alleged altered check scheme that netted over $37,000
lead_independence.lead: The Indian River County Sheriff's Office arrested Chavi Rose-Marie Hammock, 23, of Vero Beach on Aug. 28 on an active warrant charging her with grand theft and uttering a forged instrument. Investigators said Hammock deposited altered checks into a TD Bank account and later withdrew large amounts of cash, including one check that was changed from $800 to $17,658 before it was deposited.
